outcome: Childhood overweight at 3-5 years of age
Childhood overweight at 6-8 years of age
cohort: The study participants consisted of 1681 woman-child pairs from six central urban districts of Tianjin, China, followed up for 8 years.
finding: LGA and high WLR at birth were associated with an increased risk of childhood overweight at 3-5 and 6-8 years of age, respectively, while low WLR at birth was associated with a decreased risk of childhood overweight at 6-8 years of age.
birth_weight: High and low weight/length ratios (WLR) at birth were defined as >=90th and <=10th gestational week and sex-specific percentiles; Large for gestational age (LGA) was also measured.
gest_age: Weight/length ratios (WLR) were defined by gestational week and sex-specific percentiles; Large for gestational age (LGA) was also measured.
